paginas.contenido:
In this unit, we explore the essential components of IT hardware and the complex grammar needed for technical troubleshooting and career growth.
  • RA1 & RA2: Hardware identification and reading technical documentation about peripherals.
  • RA3: Social and professional communication, focusing on the creation of a Professional CV.
  • Grammar Goals: Mastering all types of Conditionals to discuss causes, effects, and hypothetical scenarios.

💡 Nota: Esta unidad es fundamental para describir averías (causa-efecto) y para tu futura búsqueda de empleo (CV).

Peripherals are external devices connected to a computer to expand its functionality. They are classified into Input, Output, or both.
DevicePrimary UseType
WebcamVideo conferencing and recording.Input
ProjectorDisplaying images/videos on a wall.Output
RouterConnecting devices to the Internet.Input/Output
ScannerCopying documents or photos to digital.Input
FaxTransmission of information over phone lines.Input/Output
JoystickController for gaming or specialized software.Input

💡 Nota: Algunos dispositivos como el Router o el Fax son bidireccionales (Input/Output).

Conditionals explain the relationship between a condition and its result.

Zero Conditional (General Truths)

Structure: If + Present Simple, Present Simple
Example: If you add two and two, you get four.

First Conditional (Likely Situations)

Structure: If + Present Simple, Will + Infinitive
Example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

💡 Nota: El primer condicional se usa para cosas que es muy probable que ocurran en el futuro.

Used for hypothetical situations in the present or past.

Second Conditional (Impossible/Imaginary Present)

Structure: If + Past Simple, Would + Infinitive
Example: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.

Third Conditional (Past Regrets/Imaginary Past)

Structure: If + Past Perfect, Would Have + Past Participle
Example: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

💡 Nota: El tercer condicional habla de cosas que NO pasaron y sus resultados imaginarios.

Sometimes we mix tenses when the condition and the result belong to different times.

Mixed Conditionals

Used to discuss the present result of a past condition.
Example: If you hadn't missed the train, you would be here on time now.

Using 'Wish'

  • Present Wish: Wish + Past Simple. "I wish I had a faster CPU."
  • Past Regret: Wish + Past Perfect. "I wish I had backed up the data."

Essential software for any ASIR specialist includes Office Automation and specialized DBMS.
  • Spreadsheets: Help control budgets and financial reports.
  • Databases: Store structured information about clients/products.
  • MySQL: An open-source DBMS popular for its stability and web server compatibility.

💡 Nota: MySQL es la tecnología DBMS más exitosa por su rendimiento y comunidad.

A technical CV must be concise and effectively showcase your certifications and experience.

Key Sections:

  • Personal Info: Contact details.
  • Education: Academic background.
  • Technical Skills: Networking, OS management, SQL, etc.
  • Experience: Previous jobs or internships.

💡 Nota: Para un perfil ASIR, destaca tus conocimientos en virtualización y seguridad.

Understanding spoken technical English requires recognizing standard phrasal verbs.
  • Plug in: Connect a peripheral to a port.
  • Back up: Create a copy of data for security.
  • Go down: When a system or server stops working.
  • Set up: To configure or install a system.

Review these core concepts before the assessment.
  • Hardware: Know your Input/Output peripherals (Webcam, Router, Projector).
  • Conditionals: 0 (Truths), 1st (Likely), 2nd (Imaginary), 3rd (Past regrets).
  • Software: DBMS (like MySQL) are vital for data integrity.
  • CV: Keep it concise and skill-focused.
Complete this test to confirm you have mastered the Unit 6 content.

preguntas_test.q: Which peripheral device is used for retransmission of images or videos on a wall?
preguntas_test.explicacion: El proyector ('Projector') es un dispositivo de salida ('Output') que proyecta luz para mostrar imágenes en una superficie.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'Connect the Projector to the HDMI port for the presentation.'

preguntas_test.q: Conditional: 'If it ___ tomorrow, we will go to the beach.'
preguntas_test.explicacion: Usamos el primer condicional: If + Present Simple (rains), Will + Infinitive.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'If the server overheats, the alarm will sound.'

preguntas_test.q: Which type of peripheral are both the Router and the Fax?
preguntas_test.explicacion: Ambos dispositivos envían y reciben datos, por lo que son de entrada y salida simultáneamente.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The Router is handling incoming and outgoing traffic.'

preguntas_test.q: Conditional: 'If I ___ a billionaire, I would travel around the world.'
preguntas_test.explicacion: Segundo condicional (hipotético): Usamos 'were' para todas las personas en la cláusula del 'if'.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'If I were the admin, I would change the security policy.'

preguntas_test.q: What does 'DBMS' stand for in an IT context?
preguntas_test.explicacion: DBMS es el sistema de gestión de bases de datos, como MySQL o PostgreSQL.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The DBMS crashed due to a memory leak.'

preguntas_test.q: Conditional: 'She would have passed the exam if she ___ harder.'
preguntas_test.explicacion: Tercer condicional (pasado imaginario): Usamos 'If + Past Perfect' en la condición.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'If we had backed up the data, we wouldn't have lost it.'

preguntas_test.q: Which pronoun is used with 'Wish' to express a regret about the past?
preguntas_test.explicacion: Para arrepentimientos del pasado con 'wish', usamos el Past Perfect.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'I wish I had chosen a stronger password.'

preguntas_test.q: What is the primary use of a 'Scanner'?
options: To copy a document or photo to digital
preguntas_test.explicacion: El escáner es un dispositivo de entrada ('Input') que digitaliza documentos físicos.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'Use the Scanner to upload your ID card.'

preguntas_test.q: Mixed Conditional: 'If you hadn't missed the train, you ___ here on time now.'
preguntas_test.explicacion: Condicional mixto: Condición pasada (Past Perfect) con resultado en el presente (Would + Infinitive).
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'If they hadn't patched the server, it would be vulnerable now.'

preguntas_test.q: Which section of a CV includes your certifications and technical knowledge?
preguntas_test.explicacion: En el sector IT, la sección 'Technical Skills' es la más importante para listar herramientas y lenguajes.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'List CCNA and AWS in your Technical Skills section.'
